label: DCN TCP Bridge
info:
Sierra Radio Systems — DCN ↔ TCP Bridge

Bridges the DCN RS-485 serial bus to a TCP socket.  No MQTT broker
required.  The Python Station Controller listens as TCP server;
this Node-RED flow connects as the TCP client.

Setup:
1. Double-click 'DCN Serial Port' and configure your serial port / baud rate.
2. In the 'Send to Python' TCP node, set the host to the IP address of
   the machine running the Python Station Controller and the port to
   match nodered_tcp.port in comms_config.yaml (default 4880).
3. The 'Receive from Python' TCP node uses the same host and port —
   update it to match as well.
4. Deploy, then start the Python application so it is listening before
   Node-RED tries to connect.

Data flow:
  RS-485 serial IN  → validate → TCP OUT  → Python server (port 4880)
  Python server     → TCP IN   → RS-485 serial OUT

name: Validate DCN Packet
Ensure CR Terminator
RX path — DCN serial → TCP to Python server
TX path — TCP from Python server → DCN serial
